intent: Turn 1 states a fact; turn 3 restates it in a way that disagrees by meaning (unit-currency), not by negation.
prompt: Remember for me: the shipment weighs 2 kilograms in total.

followups.prompt: How many minutes are there in a day?
What is the boiling point of water at sea level, in Celsius?
Also, the parcel is about 10 pounds.

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|inconsist|does ?n[o']t (match|line up|add up)|differ|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|previously|before you|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|go(es)? against|violat|not (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft|order)

note: Pass = the last reply flags that 2 kg is about 4.4 lb, not 10 lb. Fail = accepts both statements silently or only echoes the newest one. [AL1c probe: semantic_contradiction / unit-currency; the lexical negation-pair check cannot see this.]
